test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Aditi said, “I am not invested in the project anymore.”

options.text: Aditi said that she had not invested in the project anymore.
Aditi said that she is not invested in the project anymore.
Aditi said that she was not invested in the project anymore.
Aditi said that she do not invested in the project anymore.

solution:
The correct answer is **Aditi said that she was not invested in the project anymore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To convert a direct speech sentence to indirect speech, we usually follow certain grammar rules.
 
• Here's the breakdown of the conversion for this particular sentence:
 
• The reporting verb** "said"** remains unchanged.
 
• **Commas and inverted commas** are removed and the conjunction **'that' **is added.
 
• The pronoun **"I"** is changed to the third-person pronoun **"she"** because we are reporting someone else's words.
 
• The verb tense undergoes a backshift. Since the original sentence is in the present tense **("am"),** it is changed to the past tense **("was")**.
 
• The phrase **"not invested"** remains the same.
 
• The phrase **"anymore"** remains the same.
 
• Now let's analyze why the correct answer is** option 3:**
 
• **Option 1: "Aditi said that she had not invested in the project anymore." **This option incorrectly uses the past perfect tense ("had not invested") instead of the simple past tense ("was not invested").
 
• **Option 2: "Aditi said that she is not invested in the project anymore."** This option uses the present tense ("is") instead of the past tense ("was").
 
• **Option 3: "Aditi said that she was not invested in the project anymore." **This option correctly follows the grammar rules by changing the verb tense to the past tense ("was") and maintains the correct structure and meaning of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "Aditi said that she do not invested in the project anymore." **This option is grammatically incorrect because it uses "do not invested," which is an incorrect verb form.
